verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a live llms.txt index (probe HTTP 200) with explicit agent usage instructions, per-guide plain-text exports, llms-full.txt, a plain-text API reference and an OpenAPI schema (probed live with 174 paths). It also runs an unauthenticated Developer MCP docs server, confirmed by a live probe. Every element of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is covered by first-party documentation and hands-on probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
